assets.owner_core:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: actual transparent animation sprite atlas for RoomCrew, a cozy isometric office. Match the reference's softly painted detailed chibi game art, three-head adult proportions, thin colored lines, beautiful hair/cloth volume, warm top-left lighting, elevated 3/4 2:1 isometric camera. Full body characters only, no floor shadow, no grid, no numbers, no text, no background. Real alpha transparency. One figure per cell; no overlapping figures or detached props. Every row has EIGHT equally spaced figures; EIGHT rows total (64 figures), consistent identity, scale and baseline. Aim square 2048 PNG, generous gaps. Preserve costume and face throughout. Visible arms, shoes and props belong to each individual figure.
Reference image is STYLE reference only. Character: An original adult male studio owner, age about 32, neat dark brown side-parted hair, warm eyes, tan tailored casual blazer over ivory shirt, dark brown trousers, dark leather loafers. Friendly capable expressive face. Same painterly cozy style as reference, but distinct identity and tan outfit.
CORE SHEET layout, 8 columns x 8 rows, read left to right. R1: 8 natural WALK SE keyframes, alternating planted feet, arm counter-swing, weight transfer. R2: 8 RUN SE keyframes, bent knees, forward lean, contact and flight. R3: 8 WALK NE keyframes, true back 3/4, back of head and clothes. R4: 8 RUN NE keyframes, true back 3/4. R5: 8 SITTING using small smartphone SE, NO chair drawn, knees bent and shoes visible; scroll, blink, tiny breathing. R6: 8 STANDING using smartphone SE, scroll/pause/blink. R7 cells 1-4 standing idle SE breath/blink, cells 5-8 standing idle NE true back. R8 cells1-2 sitting idle SE, cells3-4 sitting idle NE, cells5-6 half-crouched sit-down poses SE, cells7-8 politely raised hand asking SE. Keep standing body height and shoe baseline consistent; seated hips lower naturally. No desk or chair in any frame.
